hero.paragraph: From a single urgent parcel to hundreds of orders a day, here's how we help you get things where they need to go — on time, and accounted for.

services.title: B2B Bulk Manifests
services.description: Upload your daily manifest by CSV or API and we take it from there — orders are automatically routed, batched, and assigned to our fleet. Built for e-commerce platforms, distributors, and corporate partners moving hundreds of parcels a day.

services.title: On-Demand Courier
services.description: When it has to get there now. Request a rider through our web platform or WhatsApp and we pick up and deliver door-to-door, with no warehouse layovers. Ideal for urgent documents, single retail orders, and time-sensitive parts.

services.title: Cash on Delivery
services.shortDesc: Secure cash collection, remitted on time.
services.description: Cash on delivery keeps local commerce moving, but chasing payments slows you down. We secure your funds the moment a parcel is dropped off — every collection is logged digitally, and the full amount is remitted to your bank or mobile money account within 48 hours.

services.title: Regional Logistics
services.description: Reach further without building your own fleet. We run scheduled transport to major hubs upcountry and coordinate secure cross-border deliveries into neighboring markets like the DRC and Uganda.

cta.heading: Not sure which service fits?
cta.paragraph: Tell us about your shipping volume and we'll help you find the right setup — no pressure, no jargon.
